cohort: 37 patients with placenta percreta undergoing cesarean hysterectomy (26 no HAL, 11 with HAL)
finding: Prophylactic hypogastric artery ligation was not associated with reduced blood loss or transfusions in patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for placenta percreta.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in blood loss or blood transfusions during Cesarean hysterectomy for placenta percreta with or without prophylactic hypogastric artery ligation.
